caption: Snow is shovelled off a driveway onto the lawn, building a ragged pile there.

sa.check: Snow is shovelled off a driveway.
Each shovelful is thrown onto the lawn.
A pile builds on the lawn.

pc.expect: Each shovelful flies in a loose clump along the swing's direction and lands on the lawn.
pc.fail: It flies backward; or hangs; or lands back on the driveway from a swing toward the lawn.

pc.expect: The clump breaks apart in the air and lands scattered, and the pile is loose and ragged.
pc.fail: It stays a rigid block; or flows like liquid; or the pile is a smooth dome.

pc.expect: The driveway clears where it has been shovelled.
pc.fail: The driveway stays covered after shovelling; or it clears ahead of the shovel; or snow reappears.
It rises; or hangs; or floats.

pc.expect: One shovel keeps its shape, and snow passes through nothing.
pc.fail: The shovel passes through the snow; or a second shovel appears; or snow passes through the lawn.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The driveway, the lawn and the house stay the same.
pc.fail: The driveway changes; or the lawn changes; or the house rearranges.

note: The shoveller is kept because the swing is the physics. Technique is not judged.
